subject: Ops sanity sweep and post-cutover validation for ACME private deployment
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Meghan Lee <meghan@acmehealth.io>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Ops sanity sweep windows for ACME private cutover

Hi team,

We're lining up the final sanity sweep ahead of the ACME VPC cutover next week. Proposed windows:
- Pre-cutover verification: Tue 2027-07-30 22:00-23:30 PDT (quick network checks + runbook playback)
- Post-cutover smoke: Fri 2027-08-01 09:00-11:00 PDT (short burst tests, sample traffic, KV cache warm)

Ask: can you confirm availability for the above windows? I'll own the pre-cutover playback; Hannah, can you take lead on the post-cutover validation runbook?

Quick scope: network ACLs, routing, LB health, service-to-service auth, telemetry sanity (token throughput & error rates), and two end-to-end generation checks against the pinned model variant.

Attachment: initial checklist attached (network-checklist.csv).

Connor
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Meghan Lee <meghan@acmehealth.io>
Cc: NetScale Support <support@netscale.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops sanity sweep windows for ACME private cutover

Thanks Connor — available for both windows. I've uploaded the updated runbook (runbook_v2.pdf) to the shared Drive and pulled the key steps into the body here so nothing gets missed during the live playback: 

Pre-cutover (30 Jul) playback highlights:
- Confirm physical network mapping + switch port labels with NetScale (support on CC)
- Verify BGP sessions to ACME edge (expected uptimes & route filters)
- Run ACL smoke (fail-open test then restore)
- Health-check the dedicated GPU pool and quantization profile on staging

Post-cutover (01 Aug) validation checklist:
1) Routing and DNS propagation check (internal + external endpoints)
2) Service auth token exchange (okta) x3
3) 5 sample generation calls with trace ids (record lat/p95, p99)
4) KV warm and cache-hit rate >= 60% within 30 minutes
5) Telemetry: no increase > 2x in 5xx errors vs baseline

Docs/links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cACME-runbook
JIRA: INFRA-2894 (runbook playback + cutover task list)

Attachments: runbook_v2.pdf, network-checklist.csv

Meghan — can your ops lead confirm NetScale has the switch labeling and cable map ready for Tue? If NetScale needs onsite coordination, please let us know.

-Hannah
Director, Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Meghan Lee <meghan@acmehealth.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops sanity sweep windows for ACME private cutover

Thanks Hannah — confirmed. NetScale has provided the physical cable map and the on-site technician is booked for Tue 30 Jul 21:00 local timezone to walk the labels. Our infra lead, Priya (cc: priya@acmehealth.io), will be on the call for the BGP signoff.

One note: procurement asked us to confirm the final HSM/KMS key rotation plan post-cutover. We don't need rotation during the cutover window, but we want the sequence clear (rotate after final smoke).

Meghan
Ops Manager, Acme Health

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Meghan Lee <meghan@acmehealth.io>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Post-cutover smoke: initial results and logs

Team — quick readout from the 09:00-10:30 PDT smoke run. Summary: green / minor findings. Full logs attached (postcutover-smoke-logs.zip). Key items: 

Successes:
- All LB health checks passed within 6 minutes of cutover
- 5 sample generation calls: avg latency 164ms, p95 402ms, p99 689ms (within SLA target)
- KV cache warm achieved 72% hit rate after 25 minutes
- No 5xx spikes; error rate stayed at 0.2% (baseline 0.18%)

Minor items to address (low priority):
- Trace ID 20270801-037: one request showed delayed token exchange (investigating; likely transient Okta rate limit)
- Observability: one dashboard panel retained an old metric name, will patch and redeploy by EOD

NetScale: can you confirm the interface counters during the 09:00-09:30 surge? I'll paste the specific pcap markers if you need them.

Connor

Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 18:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-cutover smoke: initial results and logs — closeout and next steps

Great work everyone — thanks for the fast turnaround. Summary and next steps: 

- Cutover: ACCEPTED (no rollback required)
- Action items: 
  * Connor: follow up on Trace ID 20270801-037 with Okta (owner, 48h)
  * Laura: patch dashboard metric name and redeploy (owner, 24h)
  * Mateo: drop the final artifacts into the archive bucket and mark the runbook as "verified" (owner, 24h)
  * NetScale: confirm interface counters and share pcap markers (owner, 24h)
  * ACME: schedule KMS rotation window after the smoke validation (Meghan/Priya)

I've marked JIRA INFRA-2894 as resolved with a comment and attached the logs. Also placed signed cutover acceptance in DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/records/ACME-deploy-sign

Attachments: postcutover-smoke-logs.zip, runbook_v2.pdf

If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll close the warroom and transition to operational support.

-Hannah
Director, Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference
